main_subject.detail: A bold blue-and-yellow skincare poster featuring CeraVe. The headline says 'VO HINH CAN NANG VUNG HANG RAO DA'. Two orange banners below read 'MUA LA CO QUA' and 'VOUCHER HAP DAN'. A young male celebrity in a yellow jacket appears at left with cream on his cheek. In the center is a giant yellow-capped CeraVe sunscreen bottle marked 'MOI' standing on geometric yellow and blue blocks, with a tiny woman figure leaning against it. Other products include a large Foaming Cleanser and Micellar Cleansing Water. Round badges say 'SPF 50+', 'KIEM DAU 12H', and 'CERAMIDES 3 THIET YEU'. Top-right countdown reads 'CON 1 NGAY' and 'NGAY 15 SALE GIUA THANG'. Bottom CTA says 'MUA NGAY TAI SHOPEE'.
main_subject.style: Bright editorial skincare campaign with oversized packshots, celebrity cutout, geometric pedestal design, and playful scale manipulation
